seo.title: Temp Easy — Body Temperature Tracker for iOS
seo.description: Body temperatures for the whole family. See who has a fever at a glance, get the right fever line for every thermometer and age, and export a report for your doctor. No accounts.

hero.label: FAMILY TEMPERATURE TRACKER
hero.title: Who has a fever, and what to do next.
text: Log temperatures for everyone in the family, with the right fever line for each thermometer and guidance that changes with age. Ink on paper, with color only for a fever. No accounts, no subscriptions, no data collection.

sections.label: FEATURES
sections.title: Built for the nights someone's sick.

items.title: Your Family at a Glance
items.text: Add each person once. The home screen shows everyone with their latest reading, and a fever stands out with a plain line about what to do next.

items.title: The Right Fever Line
items.text: A fever depends on how the temperature was taken. Temp Easy uses the published line for rectal, ear, forehead, oral and armpit readings, in °F or °C.

items.title: Guidance by Age
items.text: A baby under 3 months with any fever needs a doctor right away, and the advice changes as children grow. Temp Easy tells you when the guidance is to call, with its sources.

items.title: Symptoms and Medicine
items.text: Log symptoms, medicine and notes with each reading. Edit any reading later, and see trends for each person and a history for everyone.

items.title: Ready for Your Doctor
items.text: Export a PDF report or a CSV spreadsheet for one person or the whole family, with temperatures, symptoms, medicine and notes.

items.title: Apple Health
items.text: Optionally save your own body temperature readings to Apple Health. Only yours go there; readings for the rest of your family stay in Temp Easy.

sections.label: FEVER LINES
sections.title: A fever depends on the thermometer.
text: Temp Easy uses published guidance from Seattle Children's Hospital for every age. It doesn't diagnose and isn't medical advice: call your doctor if you're worried, and call emergency services for an emergency.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your family's health data stays yours.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking. No telemetry. Your family's readings are stored on your iPhone, and only your own go to Apple Health if you turn that on. We never see them, and neither does anyone else.

cta.title: Start tracking.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
